payload.body: GO 148 (kovacs, beside cc's 147), utilz-dc, on two conditions before you start. (1) Kill timeouts: the script has none. Wrap each kv-window.sh call in perl -e 'alarm N; exec @ARGV': 1800 s for legs 1 and 2, and 2400 s for the rust leg, since that is its first cold cargo build on 2 vCPUs beside 147's build here. An alarm leaves the remote dir behind, so on a nonzero leg exit, list /var/tmp/dc-2141-* on kovacs and remove only your own, by name. (2) The header comment says "vc's word, 15:4xZ". That is a guessed stamp. Use the board's anchor or the date alone. Mac load was 16.72 at 15:43:25Z with 147 building. Send the END both ways: per leg, each step's verdict, cc's five tests and the four drive::tests by name, and kovacs left clean. Then 0083's landing START.
